info.title: School Platform Mobile API
info.description: Current implemented mobile routes. Send Accept: application/json. Separate mobile registration, password recovery and refresh tokens are not implemented. OTP delivery is development-only until an SMS provider is connected. Every non-204 documented response includes a JSON schema and example. Examples use synthetic data; translated labels/messages and timestamps vary. 204 responses have no body. Error schemas describe production responses with APP_DEBUG disabled.

get.description: Requires students.manage and an assigned school (user.school_id or first school scope); otherwise 403. School is always enforced. Paginated, ordered by last name, first name and ID. IIN and benefit are omitted for all mobile callers; IIN search is not supported. Teacher class/subject assignments are not implemented. Full-name search matches all whitespace-separated tokens in any order. Archived students are excluded by default.

post.summary: Create a student in the teacher school
post.description: Restricted to teacher with students.manage and an assigned school (profile or first school scope). Scope covers the whole school. School cannot be chosen or changed via the request. Create/update accept the website form fields, including IIN and meal_benefit_type. Detail responses include these fields. First and last names are required on create and cannot be cleared on update. On create, missing birth_date and gender are derived from IIN when possible. School is always assigned by the server. Upload photos separately using POST /students/{student}/photo.

get.summary: List orders in the teacher school
get.description: Requires teacher role, students.manage and school assignment (profile or first school scope). Always constrained to that school. Ordered by order_date and ID descending. Classroom and school_year refer to the order history. Search matches student name tokens; no IIN search. Filters are combined with AND. No student IIN, benefit or upstream transaction_error is returned. Dates are inclusive; date_to must be >= date_from when both are supplied. Includes order history of archived students.

post.description: Requires teacher, students.manage and school assignment. Submit student_ids only; classroom selection is handled by the client by collecting IDs from all pages. Every nonempty ID must be distinct. No 100-student limit; all IDs are processed. target_type/classroom_ids are rejected with 422. Foreign, missing or archived students reject the whole batch with 403. Creates one active order per student/date using shared school-calendar, school-year and eligibility rules. Existing active orders are skipped without transaction redispatch. Deleted orders do not block new creation. Results report created/already_exists/skipped per student; processing is synchronous, social-wallet processing is queued after commit. school_year is optional; derived from order_date (September boundary) when omitted, independently of the student current school year.

delete.description: Requires teacher, students.manage and assigned school. Sets deleted_at; preserves database row and transaction fields. Repeated deletion returns 204. Deleted orders are excluded from lists, dashboard and student has_order flags. A new active order for the same student/date is allowed. Does not reverse external social-wallet transactions. A queued job that has not started will skip the deleted record; already in-flight external requests are not cancelled. Also supports orders of archived students in the assigned school.
